title: ✨ ALIGNMENT ✨
paragraphs:
✨ ALIGNMENT ✨
I’m not chasing balance anymore — I’m chasing God’s alignment.
Because when your steps match His plan, peace replaces pressure, and purpose replaces chaos. 🙏
🎬 “When the world seeks balance, heaven calls for alignment.”

“Seek first the kingdom of God and His righteousness, and all these things will be added to you.”
— Matthew 6:33 (NIV)
